guidance.statement: Target 8-10% volume growth band for full FY27
guidance.quote: we should stay in the volume region of about 8-10%

guidance.statement: Maintain 18-20% PBDIT margin guidance through FY27
guidance.quote: we are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20%

guidance.statement: Expect 8-9% pricing range in Q2 onwards given product mix differential
guidance.quote: Possibly it would be in the range of about 8-9%

guidance.statement: Industrial will grow at higher pitch than decorative going ahead
guidance.quote: industrial will continue to grow at a higher pitch than decorative

guidance.statement: VAM-VAE Phase 1 commences August 2026, reach 150,000 MT over 2-2.5 years
guidance.quote: The first phase of this initiative will commence by August

guidance.statement: Q2 margins traditionally lower due to product mix, maintain discipline on cost
guidance.quote: quarter two has traditionally been a lower margin because of the mix

delivered.statement: 9% volume growth in Q1 across all three months
Decorative segment value grew 16.6% despite high inflation
Weighted average price increase of approximately 7% in Q1
Standalone top line growth of 17%; PBDIT growth above 30%
Standalone PBDIT margin of 22%, consolidated improved to 20.6%
New products launched in 3-year window contribute 17% of revenues
Global operations grew 27% with PBT nearly doubling, broad-based
White cement plant in Fujairah fully operational at good capacity

themes: Premiumization driving mix improvement and margin resilience despite 25% inflation
Innovation-led: 17% of revenues from new products, Anti-Damp, color warranty, heat-resistant waterproofing
B2B expansion via AP Juggernaut (100+ key accounts) in infrastructure, factories, government
VAM-VAE backward integration manufacturing emulsions, first in India, drives cost competitiveness
Service differentiators: Beautiful Homes, Total Assure, Smart Assure, MetaCare expanding across segments
Regionalization with culturally-tailored packs (Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh) boosting customer engagement
risks: Material inflation 25% vs 7% pricing, creating 1800 bps gap creating margin compression risk
Raw material volatility, supply chain logistics pressure, crude derivatives dependency impacting costs
Competitive intensity at all-time high across economy, premium, luxury segments globally
Rural growth outpacing urban (T1/T2 weakness); demand conditions vulnerable to further price actions

analyst_pushback.question: How do you define 17% innovation? What margins on new products vs core?
analyst_pushback.response: 3-year launch window. Premium-luxury products support overall margins; not construction chemicals alone.

analyst_pushback.question: Is 9% volume growth sufficient given soft base and preponement from price hikes?
analyst_pushback.response: Acknowledged desire for more. Rural compensated urban weakness; within 8-10% band target.

analyst_pushback.question: When do industrial segment margins normalize? 120 bps drop vs Q1 prior year?
analyst_pushback.response: B2B pricing deferred; key accounts take time. Auto/marine performed well; refinishes slow.

analyst_pushback.question: Can you quantify low-cost inventory benefit and margin impact in Q2?
analyst_pushback.response: Difficult to quantify. Mix of newer 30-45 day inventory at higher cost offsets benefit.

tone_evidence: Confident on innovation, premiumization, and growth trajectory, but cautious on inflation volatility and margin pressure ahead despite 7% price increases taken.
